# Wonderfall

> Animated desktop effects for Mac by Andrii (Andrew) Sereda. The Mac App Store app ID is 6755106853. Wonderfall was formerly named SnowMyScreen; both names refer to the same app.

## Wonderfall for Mac
- Requires macOS 14.6 or later; Mac only.
- Seasonal effects: falling snow, rain, autumn leaves, spring petals and summer fireflies.
- Custom images (common formats and SVG) can move like snow, leaves or rain. Import up to 10 at once; the app prepares the size automatically.
- Version 1.6 (November 2026) is the current App Store release. Penguins waddle and slide across the snow when called from the menu, a Snowman Wardrobe dresses the snowmen you build, and a Decoration Inventory places more Christmas trees that can be decorated in place. Version 1.5 added tree ornaments, lights that sway in the wind and a choice of cleaning vehicles. In 1.4, Santa and his reindeer fly across the screen now and then, a decorated Christmas tree can stand on the desktop, cleaning tools wait on a rack at the bottom of the screen, and keyboard shortcuts start a cleaning tool or snow play from any app. Earlier releases added snow that settles on top of open windows, the snow bank can be rolled into snowballs and a snowman, and a snowplow clears it. Decorative lights with eight scenes hang along the menu bar. Interactive tools clear snow, leaves, petals and raindrops.
- Place the overlay over open windows or on the desktop behind them, while keeping the existing wallpaper.
- Controls include intensity, size, speed and wind. Snow can pile up at the bottom of the screen and be cleared with a shovel.
- Optional weather matching uses location permission and Apple WeatherKit.
- Rain is a visual effect without ambient rain audio.
- US store price checked on 2026-11-26: US$3.99. Prices depend on the region and may change; the App Store is the source of pricing.
- The app is a desktop overlay, not a replacement for wallpaper or the macOS screensaver.
